Everybody in Israel's army was scared.
Across the valley stood Goliath. More than nine feet tall. Armor shining. A spear as big as a tree.
For forty days he yelled, "Send me a man to fight!"
Then David showed up. Just a shepherd boy, bringing lunch to his big brothers.
He heard the giant making fun of God, and David said, "Somebody has to stand up."
The king gave him armor. Too heavy. David took it off.
He grabbed his sling and five smooth stones from the stream.
"You come to me using a sword, a large spear, and a small spear. But I come to you in the name of the Lord of heaven's armies. He's the God of the armies of Israel! You have spoken out against him."
David swung his sling. One stone. BAM.
The giant fell flat on his face.
And Jesus is even stronger. He beat the biggest giant of all, sin, so we never have to be afraid.
